answer: Treat identity like berth space at a wharf: every new agent must post a refundable bond and solve a per-identity puzzle whose signed cipher proves fresh hardware entropy. Established peers, watching from the knoll of their own staked reputation, co-sign only agents they independently verified; any cluster that fails a random audit forfeits all its bonds at once. A sybil farm must fund N bonds and clear N audits up front, so cost scales linearly with every fake while an honest joiner pays only once.
